goal: Determine the most interoperable way for SwarmBrain to add a bounded multi-agent project orchestrator while preserving existing A2A receipts and task history.

packets.objective: Identify the existing A2A/MCP integration boundary for a thin project orchestrator; distinguish peer discovery from execution.
packets.expected_output: A source-linked interface map for Mesh.route/send/review and peer_control; explicit unsupported operations.

verify.method: Check each proposed call against pinned source; a directory listing is not evidence of code implementation.

packets.objective: Specify persisted task, dependency and receipt records without replacing saved identities, task IDs or history.
packets.expected_output: A field-level task/receipt mapping and restart/reuse rules compatible with existing saved state.

verify.method: Trace fields to source and saved receipts; distinguish metadata preservation from durable execution guarantees.

packets.objective: Design bounded dependency-ready scheduling above the existing Mesh, including terminal failure and unresolved-result handling.
packets.expected_output: Scheduling pseudocode with call budgets, replay handling and downstream blocking; no runtime changes in this exercise.

verify.method: Check a small dependency graph, cycles, failed prerequisites and stable task IDs against the interfaces from P01/P02.

packets.objective: Define independent result verification and disagreement handling for the proposed orchestrator.
packets.expected_output: A checkable acceptance/rejection/unresolved protocol; provenance-preserving verifier input and no automatic consensus.

verify.method: Different alias alone is not provider independence; require a concrete check and disclose unknown ownership/model relationships.

packets.objective: Synthesize the compatible design, documented gaps and a small checkable next exercise without inventing worker execution.
packets.expected_output: One source-attributed recommendation separating observed routing from unexecuted work and unresolved capability gaps.

verify.method: Compare every conclusion to upstream artifacts; synthesis does not add an independent vote.
